title: Relation between simulated tracks
statement: Let $c_0$ be a configuration with $m$ work tapes, and let $g$ and $d$ be configurations of machines with respectively $m+k_D$ and $k_D$ work tapes, on the input and virtual input determined by a call specification and register-word assignment. A track relation at segment $s$, parity $a$, direction $b$, and track position $t$ requires that $s$ be among the call's segments, that $t$ be valid and consistent there, and that the simulated and virtual input-head positions agree with their prescribed positions. It also requires the first $m$ work tapes and their head positions in $g$ to match $c_0$ and the prescribed register positions, the remaining tapes and head positions in $g$ to match those of $d$, and the output of $g$ to equal the output of $c_0$.
